name: 12th Street Players
description: The 12th Street Players were formed in the late 1960s in Cicero, Illinois, on the corners of Roosevelt Road and Austin Avenue, comprised mostly of Italian-Americans and later Slavic-Americans. They expanded into surrounding western suburbs and engaged in territorial warfare with Folk Nation gangs and former People Nation allies throughout the 1980s and 1990s.
